title: Armistice Area Apportionment
statementMd:
After a drawn-out mooclear arms race, Farmer John and the Mischievous Mess Makers have finally agreed to establish peace. They plan to divide the territory of Bovinia with a line passing through at least two of the $*n*$ outposts scattered throughout the land. These outposts, remnants of the conflict, are located at the points $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}), (*x*_{2}, *y*_{2}), ..., (*x*_{*n*}, *y*_{*n*})$.

In order to find the optimal dividing line, Farmer John and Elsie have plotted a map of Bovinia on the coordinate plane. Farmer John's farm and the Mischievous Mess Makers' base are located at the points $*P* = (*a*, 0)$ and $*Q* = ( - *a*, 0)$, respectively. Because they seek a lasting peace, Farmer John and Elsie would like to minimize the maximum difference between the distances from any point on the line to $*P*$ and $*Q*$.

Formally, define the **difference** of a line ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png) relative to two points $*P*$ and $*Q*$ as the smallest real number $*d*$ so that for all points $*X*$ on line ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png), $|*PX* - *QX*| ≤ *d*$. (It is guaranteed that $*d*$ exists and is unique.) They wish to find the line ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png) passing through two distinct outposts $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$ and $(*x*_{*j*}, *y*_{*j*})$ such that the difference of ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png) relative to $*P*$ and $*Q*$ is minimized.

## Input

The first line of the input contains two integers $*n*$ and $*a*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$, $1 ≤ *a* ≤ 10 000$) — the number of outposts and the coordinates of the farm and the base, respectively.

The following $*n*$ lines describe the locations of the outposts as pairs of integers $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$ ($|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10 000$). These points are distinct from each other as well as from $*P*$ and $*Q*$.

## Output

Print a single real number—the difference of the optimal dividing line. Your answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed $10^{ - 6}$.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is $*a*$, and the answer of the jury is $*b*$. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png).

## Note

In the first sample case, the only possible line ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png) is $*y* = *x* - 1$. It can be shown that the point $*X*$ which maximizes $|*PX* - *QX*|$ is $(13, 12)$, with ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d4f8c9a4f500c322cb3725c981acd02ebf8d8b35.png), which is ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f488f414e882e7593bfa43cb26e56aaa8072b748.png).

In the second sample case, if we pick the points $(0, 1)$ and $(0,  - 3)$, we get ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png) as $*x* = 0$. Because $*PX* = *QX*$ on this line, the minimum possible difference is $0$.
statementZhMd:
经过一场旷日持久的 mooclear 军备竞赛，Farmer John 和 Mischievous Mess Makers 终于同意建立和平。他们计划用一条经过分散在 Bovinia 各地的 $*n*$ 个前哨站中至少两个的直线，将 Bovinia 的领土一分为二。这些前哨站是冲突的遗留物，位于点 $(*x*_{1}, *y*_{1}), (*x*_{2}, *y*_{2}), ..., (*x*_{*n*}, *y*_{*n*})$。

为了找出最优的分界线，Farmer John 和 Elsie 在坐标平面上绘制了 Bovinia 的地图。Farmer John 的农场和 Mischievous Mess Makers 的基地分别位于点 $*P* = (*a*, 0)$ 和 $*Q* = ( - *a*, 0)$。由于他们希望实现长久的和平，Farmer John 和 Elsie 想要最小化直线上任意点到 $*P*$ 和 $*Q*$ 的距离之差的最大值。

形式化地，定义一条直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png) 相对于两个点 $*P*$ 和 $*Q*$ 的**差值**为满足以下条件的最小实数 $*d*$：对于直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png) 上的所有点 $*X*$，均有 $|*PX* - *QX*| ≤ *d*$。（保证 $*d*$ 存在且唯一。）他们希望找到一条经过两个不同前哨站 $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$ 和 $(*x*_{*j*}, *y*_{*j*})$ 的直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png)，使得该直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png) 相对于 $*P*$ 和 $*Q*$ 的差值最小。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含两个整数 $*n*$ 和 $*a*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 100 000$，$1 ≤ *a* ≤ 10 000$）——前哨站的数量，以及农场和基地的坐标。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行描述前哨站的位置，每行包含一对整数 $(*x*_{*i*}, *y*_{*i*})$（$|*x*_{*i*}|, |*y*_{*i*}| ≤ 10 000$）。这些点两两不同，并且也不同于 $*P*$ 和 $*Q*$。

## 输出格式

输出一个实数——最优分界线的差值。如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 $10^{ - 6}$，则会被判定为正确。

具体来说：假设你的答案为 $*a*$，标准答案为 $*b*$。若 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png)，校验程序会认为你的答案正确。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，唯一可能的直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png) 是 $*y* = *x* - 1$。可以证明，使 $|*PX* - *QX*|$ 最大的点 $*X*$ 是 $(13, 12)$，此时 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d4f8c9a4f500c322cb3725c981acd02ebf8d8b35.png)，其值为 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f488f414e882e7593bfa43cb26e56aaa8072b748.png)。

在第二个样例中，如果选择点 $(0, 1)$ 和 $(0,  - 3)$，得到的直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c7c068229f25f741e2c902b657ba04a42feb0752.png) 为 $*x* = 0$。由于在这条直线上 $*PX* = *QX*$，因此可能的最小差值为 $0$。
